cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, just taught the people a whole song about the LORD, the Rock (Deuteronomy 32:4). Now he recites every word of it so all the people can hear, and friend, I once lost my place in "Happy Birthday" with four Millers staring right at me. Moses isn't up there by himself, though.

cards.question: Moses recites the song to Israel with someone beside him. Who is it?

cards.text: Joshua son of Nun, the man the LORD commissioned to bring Israel into the land (Deuteronomy 31:23). Moses finishes every last word of the song, and just when you think he's done, he's got ONE MORE THING to say to all Israel, like me at the oven door yelling "one more batch" at midnight.

cards.question: Moses tells all Israel to take his words to heart. Why does he say they should?

answers.text: So they can command their children to follow the law
So they can teach the law to the nations nearby
So they can carve the law on the city gates

cards.text: Moses tells them these are "not idle words" for Israel. In other words, this is NOT one of those warranty cards in my old junk drawer that nobody ever read.

cards.question: Moses says these words aren't idle for Israel. What reason does he give?
True or false: Moses says that by these words, Israel will live long in the land across the Jordan.

cards.text: On that SAME DAY, the LORD speaks to Moses. This man just recited a whole song to all Israel, and I need a lie-down after stamping one tray.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to go up into the Abarim Range to Mount ___.

cards.text: Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab, right across from Jericho. Friend, if the LORD told ME to climb a mountain, I'd be at the bottom on my gold base, hopping and yelling "ALMOST THERE" for a month.

cards.question: Once Moses is up on Mount Nebo, the LORD tells him to ___ the land of ___.
Then the LORD tells Moses what will happen to him there on Mount Nebo. What is it?

answers.text: He will die and be gathered to his people
He will be taken up into heaven alive
He will stay there and pray for Israel

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses he'll die on the mountain just like someone in his family did. Who?

cards.text: His brother Aaron, who died on Mount Hor. Then the LORD tells Moses why, and it goes back to the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says only Aaron broke faith with Him at Meribah-kadesh.

cards.text: Both of them broke faith with Him, the LORD says, by failing to treat Him as holy in front of the Israelites. So what does that mean for Moses and the land?

cards.question: True or false: The LORD tells Moses he will see the land from a distance but will not enter it.

cards.text: That's a heavy day for Moses, friend. But his story's not over yet, so don't you DARE take off that apron.

findings.problem: The joke adds something new to Papa Dorin's backstory. It says he lost his place singing "Happy Birthday" with "four Millers" watching. The backstory never says how many Millers there are or that he sang at birthdays. The joke also takes place in the Millers' kitchen, not his bakery, so it isn't one of the small bakery moments jokes are allowed to invent.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.

findings.problem: The right answer stands out. "Because they are your life" repeats the verse's wording and switches to "your," while the question speaks of Israel in the third person. It also sounds weighty and Bible-like next to the flat wrong answers "Because they are very old" and "Because the elders agreed."

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
